## Advising & Mentoring

David chairs dissertation committees for doctoral students in the Education Policy program — currently including Sarah Montana, Deborah Euzebio, Ditra Backup, Tracee Matthias, Nandi Carson, Kathleen Perry, Danett Song, Jiehui Zhao, Renata Lyons, and Erin Janulis — and regularly serves as a committee member for students in Public Policy, Economics, and Measurement, Statistics, and Evaluation.

He also mentors junior faculty (currently Meghan Comstock and Jing Liu) and postdoctoral fellows — recent postdocs include Kayla Bill (2023–2025, now at Florida State University) and Francisco Lagos (2022–2024, placed at the Inter-American Development Bank).

Prospective students interested in teacher labor markets, causal inference in education, or educator diversity are welcome to reach out — see the [Contact](index.qmd) section on the home page.
